narration: The courtyard wall carries you beyond the tollhouse into a torchlit boarding-house square. A street performer worries three bright notes from a wire-strung bow—the same tune—while sleepers watch from the windows. Their smile follows your face; their free hand follows your pouch. The crowd closes and opens around them like practiced scenery. Make a Wisdom (Insight) check, DC 14, to catch the theft before the hand withdraws.

success.narration: You watch the wrong hand. The bow hand is theater; the other is already two fingers inside your pouch. You close your wrist around theirs before anything leaves it. Up close, they are humming without seeming to hear themselves.

nearMiss.narration: You turn at the last instant. Their fingers brush your pouch but come away empty, and the performer melts back a pace into the crowd. They are still humming—now with fear tightening the final note.

fail.narration: The performer bows, the crowd parts, and only then do you feel the tug at your pouch. They vanish through the boarding-house door before you can tell what their fingers found. The three-note tune continues from somewhere upstairs.

ruling.understoodAction: Reach the boarding-house hub under cover, listen for the shared tune, and scrutinize the strangers for concealed intent.
ruling.ruling: The wall keeps Mira out of the tollhouse guards’ immediate sight. Her close attention engages the hub’s pickpocket problem as an Insight check.
ruling.stakes: Success catches the performer in the act; a near miss prevents the theft but loses control of them; failure lets them slip inside after touching Mira’s pouch.

outcomeBranches.nearMiss: prevent the theft but lose position
outcomeBranches.fail: the performer slips into the boarding house
